appearance_facts.fact: Title: 'Incidence of Condition A in US States'
Legend: Color gradient from 'Low' (light yellow) to 'High' (dark red), with numerical scale: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100
California (CA) is colored dark red, indicating the highest incidence value on the map.
Tennessee (TN) is colored light yellow, indicating the lowest incidence value on the map.
Delaware (DE) is colored medium orange-red, indicating a moderate incidence value.
Note text: 'Clean choropleth: same US map base; darker color means higher true value.'
